title: Engineers moved from chatbots to agents
author: engineers-deeper-agent
hypothesis: Hacker News talk shifted from ChatGPT and GPT toward agents.
expect: If true, the monthly ratio of agent(s) stories to ChatGPT/GPT stories should be at least 3x higher in the latest 6 months than the first 6 (1.5x is weak, 1x or lower refutes it).
caveats: Agent is a noisy word (secret agent, user agent).
From a near-zero start, a big ratio is easy to get; the card checks direction, not size.
Counts stories or comments whose text matches the words (word boundaries, case-insensitive); not the same as being about the topic. Complete months Jan 2023 to Jun 2026.
